paragraphs: Today, every business is a technology business. At Insight, we accelerate transformation by unlocking the power of people and technology. We turn complexity into clarity, helping clients achieve meaningful business outcomes and drive real results at scale. We serve these clients in North America; Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"); and Asia-Pacific ("APAC"). As a Fortune 500-ranked Solutions Integrator, we deliver secure, end-to-end digital transformation and meet the needs of our clients through a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, far-reaching partnerships and 37 years of broad IT expertise. We amplify our solutions and services with global scale, local expertise and our e-commerce experience, enabling our clients to realize their digital ambitions in multiple ways. Our offerings in North America and certain countries in EMEA and APAC include hardware, software and services, including cloud solutions. Our offerings in the remainder of our EMEA and APAC segments consist largely of software and certain software-related services and cloud solutions.
The Company is organized in the following three operating segments, which are primarily defined by their related geographies:
North America United States and Canada 81% EMEA Europe, Middle East and Africa 16% APAC Asia-Pacific 3%

*Additional detailed segment and geographic information can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 and in Note 20 to the Consolidated Financial Statements in Part II, Item 8 of this report.

Insight began operations in Arizona in 1988, incorporated in Delaware in 1991 and completed our initial public offering in 1995. Our corporate headquarters are located in Chandler, Arizona. From our original location in the United States, we expanded nationwide and then entered Canada in 1997 and the United Kingdom in 1998. Through a combination of acquisitions and organic growth, we continue to increase our geographic coverage and expand our technical capabilities. Our recent acquisitions from 2023 through today include:

•2023 - Amdaris Group Limited ("Amdaris") is a service provider with core expertise in providing software application and development services for clients, which added to Insight's global application and Data & artificial intelligence ("AI") practices. Amdaris also specializes in customized solutions for cloud, mobile, data analytics and web application development helping clients digitally transform faster.

•2023 - SADA Systems, LLC ("SADA") is a Google cloud service provider with engineering capabilities across the entire Google Cloud stack specializing in Google Cloud priority workloads. The SADA acquisition positions us to further benefit from the growing trend of multicloud adoption and Gen AI, accelerating Insight's progress toward its strategic objective of growing cloud services and solutions.

•2024 - Infocenter.io ("Infocenter") is a leader in digital transformation, leveraging their deep expertise in ServiceNow's comprehensive suite of capabilities. The Infocenter acquisition increases our relevance to our clients driving digital transformation in their organizations.
•2024 - New World Tech Limited ("NWT") is a consultancy-led company that provides technology strategy and transformation services.

•2025 - Inspire11 LLC ("Inspire11") is an award-winning technology delivery firm with deep expertise in advisory, data, and AI. Through its advanced capabilities and outcome-driven approach, Inspire11 helps empower us to close the AI gap by transforming bold ideas into tangible business outcomes with real-world impact.

•2025 - Sekuro Limited ("Sekuro"), is a global cybersecurity and digital resilience provider that offers end-to-end security services for enterprises and governments. The acquisition significantly expands our
cybersecurity capabilities in APAC, positioning us to better meet the growing demand for comprehensive security solutions in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

Our purpose: We solve our clients' technology challenges by combining the right hardware, software, and services. We live by our core values of hunger, heart and harmony, which guide how we act as an organization and as a team, capturing the essence of our culture, and reminding us of what we've promised to live up to every day.

We believe that these values strengthen the overall Insight experience for our clients, partners and teammates. We refer to our customers as "clients," our suppliers as "partners" and our employees as "teammates".

paragraphs: The IT hardware, software and services industry is intensely competitive, and actions of our competitors, including manufacturers and publishers of products we sell, can negatively affect our business. Competition in the industry is based on price, product availability, speed of delivery, credit availability, quality and breadth of product lines, and, increasingly, on the ability to provide services and tailor specific solutions to meet client needs. Many of our manufacturer and publisher partners are also our competitors, as many sell directly to business customers, particularly large enterprise and corporate customers. In addition to the manufacturers and publishers of products we sell, we compete with a large number and wide variety of providers and resellers of IT hardware, software and services. We believe our industry will see further consolidation as product resellers and direct marketers combine operations or acquire or merge with other resellers, service providers and direct marketers to increase efficiency, service capabilities and market share. Moreover, current and potential competitors have established or may establish cooperative relationships among themselves or with third parties to enhance their product and service offerings. Accordingly, it is possible that new competitors or alliances among competitors may emerge and acquire significant market share.

The competitive landscape in which we operate continues to change as new technologies are developed. While innovation helps our business as it creates new offerings for us to sell, it can also disrupt our business model and create new and stronger competitors. For instance, while cloud-based solutions present an opportunity for us and make up a significant part of our business and future, cloud-based solutions and technologies developed by manufacturer and publisher partners are alternatively marketed directly to customers without utilizing solutions providers like us, which can reduce the volume of hardware, software or services we sell, leading to a reduction in our sales and/or profitability. Accordingly, we are dependent on continued
innovations by our current vendor partners and our ability to partner with new and emerging technology providers.

Generally, pricing competition is very aggressive in the industry, and we expect pricing pressures to continue. There can be no assurance that we will be able to negotiate prices as favorable as those negotiated by our competitors or that we will be able to offset the effects of price reductions with an increase in the number of clients, higher net sales, cost reductions or higher sales of services, which are typically at higher gross margins, or otherwise. Price reductions by our competitors that we either cannot or choose not to match could result in an erosion of our market share and/or reduced sales or, to the extent we match such reductions, could result in reduced operating margins or inventory impairment charges, any of which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Some of our competitors in each of our operating segments may have greater technical, marketing and other resources than we do. In addition, some of these competitors may be able to respond more quickly to new or changing opportunities, technologies and client requirements. Many current and potential competitors also may have greater name recognition and engage in more extensive promotional activities, offer more attractive terms to their customers and adopt more aggressive pricing policies than we do. Additionally, some of our competitors have higher margins and/or lower operating cost structures, allowing them to price more aggressively. There can be no assurance that we will be able to compete effectively with current or future competitors or that the competitive pressures we face will not have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.

We rely on our partners for product availability, competitive products to sell and marketing funds and purchasing incentives, which can and do change significantly in the amounts made available and the requirements year over year. We acquire products for resale both directly from manufacturers and publishers and indirectly through distributors, and the loss of a significant partner relationship could cause a disruption in the availability of products to us. We typically do not have long-term contracts with our vendor partners. As such, many of these arrangements with partners are easily terminable, and there can be no assurance that manufacturers and publishers will continue to sell or will not limit or curtail the availability of their product to resellers like us. Additionally, we act as a paid pass-through agent in EMEA for certain clients and their vendors. There is no contractual requirement or guarantee that our clients and these vendors will continue to use us an agent in this capacity. The loss of, or change in business relationship with, any of our key vendor partners could negatively impact our business.

Our actual results could differ materially from those contained in forward-looking statements due to a number of factors, including those discussed in "Risk Factors" in Part I, Item 1A and elsewhere in this report.

Today, every business is a technology business. At Insight, we accelerate transformation by unlocking the power of people and technology. We turn complexity into clarity, helping clients achieve meaningful business outcomes and drive real results at scale. We serve these clients in North America; Europe, the Middle East and Africa ("EMEA"); and Asia-Pacific ("APAC"). As a Fortune 500-ranked Solutions Integrator, we deliver secure, end-to-end digital transformation and meet the needs of our clients through a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, far-reaching partnerships and 37 years of broad IT expertise. We amplify our solutions and services with global scale, local expertise and our e-commerce experience, enabling our clients to realize their digital ambitions in multiple ways. Our offerings in North America and certain countries in EMEA and APAC include hardware, software and services, including cloud solutions. Our offerings in the remainder of our EMEA and APAC segments consist largely of software and certain software-related services and cloud solutions.
Full year 2025 financial and operational highlights included the following:
•We reported gross profit of $1.8 billion and record gross margin of 21.4%, primarily driven by margin expansion in North America and EMEA.
•We generated cash flows from operations of $303.8 million.
•We strengthened our capabilities through two strategic acquisitions: Inspire11, enhancing our AI and data expertise, and Sekuro, expanding cybersecurity and digital resilience across APAC.
On a consolidated basis, for the year ended December 31, 2025:
•Net sales of $8.2 billion decreased 5% compared to 2024.
•Gross profit of $1.8 billion was relatively flat compared to 2024.

•Consolidated gross margin expanded approximately 110 basis points to a record 21.4% of net sales in 2025. This increase reflects expansion in margin from services net sales, primarily from growth in other agency transactions and Insight Core services.
•Earnings from operations decreased to $334.9 million in 2025, a decrease of 14% compared to the prior year, which represented 4.1% of net sales.
•Our effective tax rate in 2025 was 30.3%, compared to our effective tax rate of 25.0% in 2024.
•Net earnings and diluted net earnings per share were $157.3 million and $4.86, respectively, in 2025. In 2024, we reported net earnings of $249.7 million and diluted net earnings per share of $6.55.

paragraphs: 今天，每一家企業都是科技企業。在 Insight，我們透過釋放人力與科技的潛力來加速轉型。我們將複雜性轉化為清晰度，協助客戶實現有意義的業務成果，並在規模上驅動實質的成果。我們在北美；歐洲、中東及非洲（"EMEA"）；以及亞太（"APAC"）地區為這些客戶提供服務。作為一家《財富》500 強的解決方案整合商，我們提供安全、端到端的數位轉型，透過廣泛的解決方案組合、遠距的合作夥伴關係以及 37 年的廣泛資訊科技經驗，來滿足客戶的需求。我們透過全球規模、本地專業知識以及電商經驗來強化我們的解決方案與服務，使客戶能以多種方式實現其數位願景。我們在北美以及 EMEA 和 APAC 中某些國家的業務，包括硬體、軟體與服務，包括雲端解決方案。我們在 EMEA 和 APAC 其餘地區的業務，則主要為軟體與某些與軟體相關的服務以及雲端解決方案。
本公司分為以下三個營運分部，這些分部主要根據其相關地理區域來界定：
北美 美國與加拿大 81% EMEA 歐洲、中東及非洲 16% APAC 亞太 3%
"額外詳細的分部與地理資訊可於本報告第二部分第 7 項「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」以及第二部分第 8 項「合併財務報表附註 20」中找到。"
Insight 於 1988 年在亞利桑那州開始營運，於 1991 年在特拉華州設立公司，並於 1995 年完成首次公開發行股票。本公司總部位於亞利桑那州錢德勒。從我們最初的美國據點出發，我們擴展至全美，並於 1997 年進入加拿大，1998 年進入英國。透過收購與內生性成長的結合，我們持續擴大地理覆蓋範圍並提升技術能力。我們從 2023 年至今的近期收購包括：
•2023 - Amdaris Group Limited（"Amdaris"）是一家服務供應商，核心專業在於為客戶提供軟體應用與開發服務，這項收購為 Insight 的全球應用與資料與人工智慧（"AI"）業務增添實力。Amdaris 同時專精於雲端、行動、資料分析與網頁應用開發的客製化解決方案，協助客戶更快實現數位轉型。
•2023 - SADA Systems, LLC（"SADA"）是一家 Google 雲端服務供應商，具備橫跨整個 Google 雲端堆疊的工程能力，專精於 Google 雲端的優先工作負載。SADA 的收購使我們能進一步受益於多雲端採用與生成式 AI 的成長趨勢，加速 Insight 向其戰略目標——擴大雲端服務與解決方案——的進展。
•2024 - Infocenter.io（"Infocenter"）是一家在數位轉型領域的領導者，善用其在 ServiceNow 全面功能組合方面的深厚專業知識。Infocenter 的收購使我們對客戶在組織內推動數位轉型的相關性進一步提升。
•2024 - New World Tech Limited ("NWT") 為一間以顧問為主導的公司，提供科技策略與轉型服務。
•2025 - Inspire11 LLC ("Inspire11") 為一間獲獎肯定的科技交付公司，具備深厚的諮詢、數據與人工智能專業知識。透過其先進的技術能力與以成果為導向的作法，Inspire11 幫助我們縮小人工智能的落差，將大膽的想法轉化為具體的商業成果，並產生實際的影響。
•2025 - Sekuro Limited ("Sekuro") 為一間全球性的網路安全與數位韌性服務提供者，為企業與政府提供端到端的安全服務。此項收購大幅擴展了我們
在亞太地區具備網路安全能力，使我們能更有效地應對日益複雜的威脅環境中，對全面性安全解決方案日益增長的需求。
我們的宗旨：我們透過結合適當的硬體、軟體與服務，解決客戶的科技挑戰。我們以「渴望、熱忱與和諧」的核心價值觀為行動準則，引導我們作為組織與團隊的行為方式，體現我們的文化本質，並提醒我們每日承諾要達成的目標。
我們相信這些價值觀能強化我們對客戶、合作夥伴與同仁的 Insight 經驗。我們將客戶稱為「客戶」，將供應商稱為「合作夥伴」，將員工稱為「同仁」。

paragraphs: 下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，應與本報告第二部分第 8 項所載之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。我們實際之結果可能因多種因素而與前瞻性陳述之內容有重大差異，包括在第一部分第 1A 項「風險因素」及其他處所討論之因素。

今日，每一家企業都是科技企業。在 Insight，我們透過釋放人力與科技的潛力，加速轉型。我們將複雜性轉化為清晰度，協助客戶實現有意義的業務成果，並在規模上驅動真實的成果。我們為這些客戶提供服務，範圍包括北美；歐洲、中東及非洲（"EMEA"）；以及亞太（"APAC"）。作為一家《財富》500 強的解決方案整合商，我們提供安全、端到端的數位轉型方案，透過廣泛的解決方案組合、遠距合作夥伴關係與 37 年的廣泛資訊科技專業知識，滿足客戶需求。我們透過全球規模、本地專業知識與電商經驗，強化我們的解決方案與服務，使客戶能以多種方式實現其數位願景。我們在北美與 EMEA 和 APAC 中某些國家所提供的產品與服務包括硬體、軟體與服務，包括雲端解決方案。我們在 EMEA 和 APAC 其他地區所提供的產品與服務則主要為軟體與某些與軟體相關的服務及雲端解決方案。
2025 年全年財務與營運重點如下：
•我們報出毛利為 1.8 十億美元，並創下 21.4% 的歷史新高毛利率，主要因北美與 EMEA 的毛利率擴張所驅動。
•我們產生營運現金流為 303.8 百萬美元。
•我們透過兩項戰略性收購強化了我們的能力：Inspire11，增強我們的 AI 與數據專業知識，以及 Sekuro，擴展我們在 APAC 的網路安全與數位韌性。
就合併財務資料而言，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止之年度：
•淨銷售額為 8.2 十億美元，較 2024 年減少 5%。
•毛利率為 1.8 十億美元，與 2024 年相比相對持平。
•合併毛利率擴張約 110 基點，至 2025 年淨銷售額的歷史新高 21.4%。此增加反映來自服務淨銷售額的邊際擴張，主要來自其他代理交易及 Insight Core 服務的成長。
•2025 年營運獲利為 334.9 百萬美元，較前一年減少 14%，佔淨銷售額的 4.1%。
•我們在 2025 年的有效稅率為 30.3%，與 2024 年的有效稅率 25.0% 相較。
•2025 年的淨利潤及稀釋後每股淨利為 157.3 百萬美元及 4.86 美元，分別。2024 年，我們報告的淨利潤為 249.7 百萬美元，稀釋後每股淨利為 6.55 美元。
2025 年的營運結果包含以下項目：•淨額 37.1 百萬美元、稅後淨額 27.6 百萬美元之遣散及重整費用。

paragraphs: 資訊科技硬體、軟體及服務產業競爭激烈，競爭對手的行動，包括我們所銷售產品的製造商與發行商，可能對我們的業務造成負面影響。產業內的競爭基於價格、產品可取得性、交貨速度、信貸可取得性、產品線的品質與廣度，以及越來越重要的，提供服務及針對客戶需求量身打造特定解決方案的能力。許多我們的製造商與發行商合作夥伴同時也是我們的競爭對手，因為許多直接銷售給企業客戶，尤其是大型企業與企業客戶。除了製造商與發行商之外，我們還與大量且種類繁多的資訊科技硬體、軟體及服務供應商與經銷商競爭。我們認為，資訊科技產業將進一步出現併購現象，產品經銷商與直銷商結合業務或收購、合併其他經銷商、服務供應商與直銷商，以提高效率、服務能力與市場佔有率。此外，現有與潛在競爭對手已建立或可能建立彼此之間或與第三方的合作關係，以強化其產品與服務的提供。因此，可能有新的競爭對手或競爭對手之間的聯盟出現，並取得顯著的市場佔有率。

我們所處的競爭環境持續變化，因新技術不斷發展。雖然創新有助於我們的業務，因為它創造了新的產品與服務供我們銷售，但它也可能幹擾我們的商業模式，並產生新的強勢競爭對手。例如，雖然雲端解決方案對我們而言是機會，且佔據我們業務與未來的重要部分，但製造商與發行商所開發的雲端解決方案與技術，有時會直接行銷給客戶，而不經由像我們這樣的解決方案供應商，這會減少我們所銷售的硬體、軟體或服務的數量，進而導致我們的銷售額與/或利潤減少。因此，我們依賴現有合作夥伴持續創新，以及我們與新興科技供應商合作的能力。

總體而言，產業中的價格競爭非常激烈，我們預期價格壓力將持續存在。無法保證我們將能談判與競爭對手同等有利的價格，或能透過增加客戶數量、提高淨銷售額、成本降低或提高服務銷售量（通常具有較高的毛利率）等方式彌補價格下降的影響，否則可能會導致我們的市佔率與/或銷售額下降，或在我們匹配這些價格下降的情況下，導致營運毛利下降或存貨減損費用，任何一種情況都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。

我們在各個營運分部的競爭對手可能擁有較多的技術、行銷及其他資源。此外，這些競爭對手可能更能迅速回應新的或變化的機會、技術與客戶需求。許多現有及潛在的競爭對手也擁有更高的知名度，進行更廣泛的促銷活動，為客戶提供更具吸引力的條件，並採用更積極的價格政策。此外，部分競爭對手擁有較高的毛利率及/或較低的營運成本結構，使其能更積極地進行價格競爭。無法保證我們將能有效與現有或未來的競爭對手競爭，或這些競爭壓力不會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。

我們依賴合作夥伴提供產品供應、競爭性產品銷售及行銷經費與採購激勵措施，這些措施在年度間會有顯著的變動。我們透過直接向製造商及出版商購入，以及透過經銷商間接購入產品進行轉售，若失去重要的合作夥伴關係，可能會導致產品供應中斷。我們通常與供應商合作夥伴沒有長期契約。因此，許多與合作夥伴的協議都很容易終止，無法保證製造商及出版商會繼續向我們這類轉售商供應產品，或不會限制或減少對我們這類轉售商的產品供應。此外，我們在EMEA地區擔任某些客戶及其供應商的付費轉傳代理商。沒有契約上的義務或保證，這些客戶及供應商會繼續使用我們作為此類代理商。失去任何關鍵供應商合作夥伴，或與其業務關係發生變動，都可能對我們的業務產生負面影響。
